a.headline: Your messages keep working even when everything else goes down.

b.headline: Stay reachable — no cell network, no account, no waiting.

c.headline: When mobile data and Wi‑Fi fail, your chat still works.

why.title: Why this app?
bullets: Your messages stay on your devices

items.question: Is this tracking me?
items.answer: No. There is no account and no ads. Messages only go to devices you connect with — we cannot read them.

items.question: Does it need Bluetooth all the time?
items.answer: No. Nearby Bluetooth and Wi‑Fi are used when you send or receive. You can turn radios on or off in Settings.

items.question: Will it drain my battery?
items.answer: For normal use you will barely notice. The app is often quiet in the background. If everything stays active, use may rise — check status in Settings.

items.question: Who is behind this?
items.answer: The app is published by the Mycena project. Mycena is open source — see “How Mycena handles your data” for details.

completion.title: What should others call you?
completion.body: You can pick a nickname. You can change it later.
completion.fresh_identity_note: Starting here creates a new identity on this device. Previous chats and contacts on this device are deleted.
completion.name_privacy_note: This name is visible to people you message. A pseudonym is fine.
